messages:
alyssa (Docs): Opening a docs PR to migrate the rate-limits / quotas page to the new metering model (metering.v2). Looking for quick SDK examples, a short migration note, and a usage dashboard screenshot for per-route meter breakdown. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1456 :sparkles:

mira (SDK): Nice. I can add JS + Python snippets. Quick question — preferred naming for the schema field: `quota_units` or `meter_units`?

dave (Platform): Recommend `meter_units` to match runtime field names. Also add a note about prefix caching affecting reported units (deduped tokens).

sam (Product): Also let's be consistent in the UI wording: show both tier names (Starter / Pro / Enterprise) and numeric examples. Users like seeing concrete thresholds.

alyssa (Docs): Great. I'll update the PR with placeholders. Mira — can you paste minimal streaming + non-streaming SDK examples that show the metering fields?

mira (SDK): Added two snippets below — one JS, one Python. Each shows attaching `metering: { units: X, reason: "..." }` to the request.

mira (SDK): ```js
// JS snippet for per-request metering metadata
const resp = await redwood.client.generate({
  model: "rw-1-large",
  input: "Summarize the transcript",
  metering: { units: 120, reason: "summaries-per-chat" }
});
console.log(resp.output);
```

mira (SDK): ```py
# Python example for attaching metering info
resp = client.generate(
  model="rw-1-large",
  input="Summarize the transcript",
  metering={"units": 120, "reason": "summaries-per-chat"}
)
print(resp.output)
```

alyssa (Docs): Perfect. Can someone grab a screenshot of the usage dashboard (monthly meter trend + per-route breakdown) from staging and upload to the PR? We need to show the `meter_units` column and a sample filter by route.

dave (Platform): I'll pull one from staging. Note: dashboard path changed — use `/console/usage/metrics?view=routes` instead of the old `/console/usage`. Also FYI telemetry now surfaces `usage.metadata.route` so add an example filter for that.

docs-bot: PR #1456 opened by alyssa — labels: docs, needs-review :eyes:

sam (Product): One wording nit: replace "quota reset" with "metering period reset" where applicable to avoid confusion with enforcement vs reporting.

alyssa (Docs): Done in the draft and pushed a commit. Also added a short migration note: "Migration notes: v1 quota fields are deprecated. Map `quota_limit` -> `meter_units` and `quota_window` -> `meter_period` (30d). See the mapping table in the PR for automated transformations."

mira (SDK): Tiny nit on the Python snippet — prefer keyword-arg style where possible; I'll open a 1-line PR if folks want that change.

dave (Platform): Also add the runtime caveat about prefix caching: "When prefix/KV caching is enabled, reported meter_units may be lower than raw token counts. Use route-level breakdowns for accurate billing reconciliation."

alyssa (Docs): Added 'Filtering by route' subsection and example dashboard filter query; included the caveat. Also fixed an old broken link to pricing/tiers (was redirecting). New link: https://redwood.ai/pricing

dora (Docs): I'll review content tomorrow morning and check the migration table for accuracy :thumbsup:

alyssa (Docs): Target merge EOD Friday if reviews and screenshot come in. Thanks all :pray:
